name: Chau Doc
provinceNote: Provincial pages in 2026 still use An Giang for the province after the merger with Kiên Giang. The portal contact line is in phường Rạch Giá. This page is the Châu Đốc base only.
dotReason: Worth a night when the Hậu river and Sam Mountain are the trip.
summary: A Mekong Delta river town on the Hau River, known for floating fish farms and the temples of Sam Mountain. Visit the fish rafts, the Ba Chua Xu temple and the Cham villages, browse the fermented-fish stalls at the market, and eat turmeric fish noodle soup. Two days suits travellers interested in faith, river life and food.
fee: Trà Sư gate 120,000 VND. Motorboat or rowboat 60,000 VND on the notice applied from 1 November 2024. Temple gates and town-boat fares: Check on arrival.
getThere: About 3 hours by car from Can Tho Airport. About 5 hours from Ho Chi Minh City on the English page, about 6 on the Vietnamese page.
bestMonths: September to November for high water
seoTitle: Chau Doc — fish rafts, Sam Mountain, Tra Su
seoDescription: Fish-raft houses on the Hậu, Sam Mountain and Ba Chua Xu, and the Tra Su cajuput forest. Stay for the river and the hill.
intro: Fish-raft houses sit on the Hậu at Châu Đốc, with Núi Sam and Miếu Bà Chúa Xứ a short road inland in phường Vĩnh Tế, and Trà Sư’s cajuput forest a half day out. The picture is olive water, a boat, and the rafts along a green bank. Sleep in a river room in phường Châu Đốc, or in a bungalow on the hill if you want the plain in the morning. The ward office is at 10 Lê Lợi. That ward was formed from Vĩnh Nguơn, Châu Phú A, Châu Phú B, Vĩnh Mỹ, and part of Vĩnh Châu.

Stay in Châu Đốc for the border river, the fish farms, Châu Phong and Đa Phước, and the temple cluster at the foot of the hill. Stay in Can Tho when Cái Răng at dawn is the point. Use one day for the market, a boat among the rafts or across to the Cham bank, and the halls at Núi Sam. Keep Trà Sư, 23 km out, for its own half day. The evening is the riverbank.
gettingAround: Boats are ordinary transport between the bank, the islets, and the fish rafts. Sam Mountain is a short road from the river wards. One national-tourism article gives both about 5 km and about 7 km. The mountain is in phường Vĩnh Tế, not inside the Châu Đốc town ward.

The bus station is on the Quốc lộ 91 bypass, Khóm Hòa Bình, phường Châu Đốc. The station site gives office hours of 07:00–11:00 and 13:00–17:00. Those are office hours, not a departure board. Luxury cruises between Can Tho and Châu Đốc, and from Cambodia, are named without an operator, a pier, or a clock.

stayAreas.name: Phường Châu Đốc river
stayAreas.summary: Small hotels along the Châu Đốc river, so the evening walk is the bank.

stayAreas.name: Núi Sam, phường Vĩnh Tế
stayAreas.summary: A bungalow on the hill if you want the plain in the morning. The 2026 festival opened here.

eat: Breakfast is bún cá at the edge of Chợ Châu Đốc, a fish-noodle soup with turmeric and crunchy điên điển flowers. Season it with chili and lime. Mắm, fish pickled with palm sugar, salt, chili, and garlic, is stacked in the market. VnExpress gives the hall at 05:30–18:00.

Dinner is lẩu mắm, the shared pot Vietnam Tourism’s place page says not to leave without, and cá kho tộ, a Mekong claypot fish eaten with rice and greens. The charms chapter names a separate seafood hotpot. Afternoon sweets are bánh bò thốt nốt, bánh bò Chăm in the villages, and chè thốt nốt.
interestsBody: Dining is bún cá and mắm at Chợ Châu Đốc, then lẩu mắm and cá kho tộ. Palm sweets and the other bowls Vietnam Tourism and VnExpress name sit with them.
Fish rafts on the Hậu, Sam Mountain and Ba Chua Xu, and Trà Sư are the reasons to stay. Châu Phong and Đa Phước are the weaving villages across the river.

interestGroups.title: Dining and F&B
interestGroups.summary: Market breakfast, mắm, and claypot fish. The food guide is the card.

cards.title: Dining and F&B
cards.summary: Bún cá at Chợ Châu Đốc, mắm in the aisles, and cá kho tộ with rice.

interestGroups.title: Shopping
interestGroups.summary: Chợ Châu Đốc for mắm, noodle bowls, and the gifts you carry home.

blocks.heading: Chau Doc Market
paragraphs: Come in the morning. VnExpress on 20 Oct 2023 gives 05:30–18:00 every day. On the edge of the hall you eat bún cá. In the aisles, mắm is stacked in the open. Sugarcane juice, flowers, and fruit sit with the bowls.
The floating market is a different hour: several dozen boats of fruit and vegetables before the town is busy, each with its produce hung on a long pole.

cards.title: Chau Doc Market
cards.summary: The hall for bún cá, mắm, and the morning walk. VnExpress gives 05:30–18:00.

interestGroups.title: Sam Mountain pilgrimage
interestGroups.summary: One morning in phường Vĩnh Tế for the hill, the shrine, Tây An, the cave pagoda, and the tomb.
body: Vietnam Tourism says about 200 large and small religious sites are scattered on the slopes. The foot of the hill is Miếu Bà Chúa Xứ, Chùa Tây An, Chùa Hang (Phước Điền), and Lăng Thoại Ngọc Hầu.
The climb, and any cable car, is a different effort from those halls. From the first lunar month through the Via festival, the halls are crowded from early morning.

cards.title: Sam Mountain
cards.summary: The sacred hill in phường Vĩnh Tế. Walk the halls at the foot, then climb if you want the plain. One article gives both about 5 km and about 7 km.

cards.title: Ba Chua Xu Temple
cards.summary: Miếu Bà Chúa Xứ at the foot of the hill. Offerings on the steps, and the statue Vietnam Tourism says was found on the mountain about 200 years ago. Come early outside festival days.

cards.title: Tay An Pagoda
cards.summary: Chùa Tây An, on the same foot-of-the-hill walk as the shrine and the tomb.

cards.title: Cave Pagoda
cards.summary: Chùa Hang, also called Phước Điền, on the slope. It is a climb, and the view from it reaches toward the plain.

cards.title: Thoai Ngoc Hau Tomb
cards.summary: Lăng Thoại Ngọc Hầu at the mountain, not at the market. The 2026 festival moves his spirit tablet between this ground and the shrine.

interestGroups.title: Tra Su by boat
interestGroups.summary: The flooded cajuput forest 23 km out. The gate ticket does not include the boat.
body: Rừng tràm Trà Sư is a wetland conservation forest west of the Hậu. A forest account says more than 845 ha. The charms chapter says 850 ha. The bamboo bridge is 2.2 km on the operator page and longer than 3,800 m on the rural-tourism page.
The standing price, applied from 1 November 2024, is 120,000 VND at the gate and 60,000 VND for a motorboat or a rowboat.

cards.title: Tra Su cajuput forest
cards.summary: A half day, 23 km from town. Walk the bamboo bridge and take a sampan through duckweed. The gate is 120,000 VND. The boat is a separate ticket.

interestGroups.title: Fish rafts on the Hau
interestGroups.summary: Raft houses that are freshwater fish farms, at the Châu Đốc river junction.
body: Vietnam Tourism calls the community about 50 years old, raising catfish and snapper. The province says the early-2024 color project painted 165 rafts in six color blocks. VnExpress gives more than 160, and also 161, over more than 1 km, beside Cồn Tiên bridge.
A boat among the rafts is the visit. Lights after dark are described.

cards.title: Fish-raft village
cards.summary: Boat among the raft houses on the Hậu and the Châu Đốc river. Counts in the sources are 165, more than 160, and 161.

interestGroups.title: Cham weaving villages
interestGroups.summary: Châu Phong and Đa Phước, on two banks of the Hậu. Mubarak is Châu Phong. It is not every mosque.
body: The province places Mubarak, Jamiul Azhar, and Nia’mah in Châu Phong, and Ihsan and Sunnah in Đa Phước. Weaving in Châu Phong was listed as national intangible cultural heritage at the end of 2023, with lifecycle rituals.
The English guide also says Châu Giang and Châu Phong sit on two islets. A 2026 commune page that still uses Châu Giang as the official name was not in this set. Keep the names apart.

cards.title: Chau Phong and Da Phuoc
cards.summary: Mosques, stilt houses, and weaving across the river. The photograph is the Jamiul Azhar gate in Châu Phong.

interestGroups.title: River evening
interestGroups.summary: Walk the Hậu bank after the mountain.
body: Vietnam Tourism’s evening chapter is this waterfront: barges, the far islets, and the rafts once the lights are on. The walk is not a ticket.
Festival nights at Núi Sam are a separate calendar. They are not this walk.

cards.title: Hau riverfront
cards.summary: The town bank in phường Châu Đốc at dusk. Stay on the river if you want to walk here.

faqs.q: Is a day trip from Ho Chi Minh City enough?
faqs.a: Sleep in Châu Đốc if you wanted a boat. Vietnam Tourism’s English place page says about five hours from Ho Chi Minh City. The Vietnamese page says about six. Stay in Can Tho if the dawn market there is the point.

faqs.q: When is the festival of Ba Chua Xu?
faqs.a: UNESCO element 01999 and the 2026 culture-department article say the 22nd to the 27th of the fourth lunar month. TITC gives the 23rd to the 27th. In 2026 the ward mapped the rites to 6–12 June.

faqs.q: Should you stay in Can Tho or Chau Doc?
faqs.a: Stay in Can Tho for Cái Răng at dawn and for the airport. Stay in Châu Đốc for the fish rafts, the Cham villages, and Núi Sam. The airport drive between them is about three hours.

season.label: High water Aug–Nov
season.note: The English Vietnam Tourism card says the rainy season is May to November and the best visit is September to November, when floodwater fills Trà Sư. The Vietnamese page says rain from May through October, high water from August to November, and dry, sunny weather from November to April. Flood is the reason to be on the water.
